title: deck3d style.json
description: The recorded creative decisions of a deck: ordered steps, each with 2-4 candidate override fragments, the pick, and the rounds taken.

source.description: The pptx or brief the deck was built from.

slides.description: Sample slide ids shown on the contact sheet.

overrides.description: Fragment in the deck overrides grammar (validated against it).

picked.description: Chosen variant name, or null when the answer was free text.

pending.description: True while a pick is half-written; any variants command then asks for a re-run.

drop.description: Effect/prop ids the pick was allowed to remove (--drop), kept so `variants replay` repeats it.

replaceStep.description: Earlier step whose effects the pick replaced (--replace-step), kept for replay.
